BREAKING: OpenAI just launched Astra 6.2 and Sol 6.2!! We've been testing them for the last few weeks @every and, unfortunately, these models aren't great. Overall a disappointing release compared to Fable 5.2. - Writing. We found Astra 6.2 to be a step back from Astra 6 on writing. 6.2 appears to have been trained to very extremely concise and actionable—so much so that its writing is hard to understand, and it gives short answers when long answers would be appropriate. - Coding. We found performance to be similar to Astra 6 on most of our benchmarks. However, in real coding tasks Astra 6.2 seemed to stop too early frequently, which made it quite frustating to use on end-to-end builds. - Design. Astra 6.2 has good default design instincts. But it struggles to vary its designs, resulting in output that has a noticeable "house style". Full vibe check coming soon on @every!
